sentence_stem: We have got a test tomorrow, so
correct_completion: we have got to study tonight.
full_sentence: We have got a test tomorrow, so we have got to study tonight.
acceptable_variants: we have to revise the lessons tonight.
we have got to review our notes tonight.

options.why_wrong: A holiday is not a reason for the test-related action, so the 'so' clause does not connect logically with the first part.

options.text: we have got to study tonight.
we has got to study tonight.
options.why_wrong: The subject 'we' takes 'have got', not 'has got'; 'has got' is only used with he, she and it.

options.text: we have got a red car.
options.why_wrong: This is unrelated to the test, so it does not give the result that 'so' needs.

grammar_focus: Have got to for obligation after a cause clause
explanation: After 'so', the sentence needs the result of the first clause. 'Have got to' expresses obligation, and it must agree with the subject 'we'.
translation: Mamy jutro sprawdzian, więc musimy się dziś uczyć.
